messages:
alisa: FYI — noticed a cluster of tenants getting non‑deterministic routing when they send mixed v1/v2 requests. console shows version_coexist spikes around 03:00 UTC.

sam: ugh. what does non-deterministic mean here? different requests from same token hitting v1 then v2?

alisa: yeah. same API key, sometimes routed to v1 then v2 within a few seconds. seems tied to header presence/TTL and our pin eviction.

raj: did we recently change pin TTLs? last change was 2 weeks ago for burst protection.

alisa: TTL is 30s for tenant pins. but clients with intermittent `x-redwood-client` header are flipping flags.

sam: do we treat header absence as a v2 hint? current logic: header -> honor version, no header -> default routing (v2). if header present but malformed -> fallback to default.

jamie: product POV — customers expect session stickiness to the first successful model response for a given conversational session. unexpected switches show up as quality regressions.

alisa: exact. example header shapes we're seeing: 
```
x-redwood-client: {"version":"v1","variant":"alpha"}
```
then later same client sends `x-redwood-client: {"version":"v1","variant":"alpha_v2"}` and we treat as different pin key.

sam: oh right, we use full header blob as pin key. that's brittle.

raj: proposal: normalize header -> only use `version` for pin key and surface `variant` as telemetry label. That'll reduce churn.

jamie: +1. Also surface an explict console affordance: show "effective pinned version" vs "client-declared version" on tenant page.

alisa: agree. normalization rules: parse JSON, strip unknown keys, lowercase, map synonyms (v1/v01 -> v1). fallback if parse error -> treat as legacy header and preserve old behavior but increment telemetry counter.

sam: for rollout safety, we should run normalization in opt-in shadow for 48h on a subset of tenants. shadow both pin decisions and record diffs in `pin_normalize_diff` metric.

raj: and add a circuit-breaker: if diff rate > 0.5% for any tenant then roll back normalization for that tenant automatically and alert #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/normalize-pin-header -> staging (canary 5%)

alisa: console needs a flag to enable normalization per-tenant. jamie can we add to the tenant settings UI: "Enable header normalization (pinning)" with tooltip?

jamie: yes — we'll add a toggle and a quick explanation. UX text: "Use only declared API version for routing pinning; variant used for analytics only."

sam: telemetry: add labels `pinned_version`, `declared_version`, `pin_key_hash`, `normalization_applied:true/false`. We should keep pin_key_hash to debug without logging raw header.

raj: also create a dashboard tile: "pin churn" (unique pin keys / 5m) and an alert when > 3x baseline for a tenant.

alisa: edge case: v1 clients sometimes send new params (new arg names) that v2 tolerates. If we normalize to version-only, some v1 clients may still break because of parameter compatibility, not routing. we need endpoint-level compat checks.

sam: agreed — add server-side schema check during canary. If v1 request contains fields unknown to v1 model we should reject with 400 and include `compat_hint` telling client to upgrade. But only when `compat_strict` is enabled for tenant.

jamie: product prefers soft warning in responses for 2 weeks before hard 400. maybe `X-Compatibility-Warning: deprecated param 'foo'` header first.

raj: ops: plan
- run normalization shadow on 5% for 48h
- monitor `pin_normalize_diff`, `pin_churn`, errors
- if stable, enable per-tenant toggle and default off for 1 week
- then flip default on with a 7-day opt-out window

alisa: timeline? can we start staging canary tomorrow?

deploy-bot: staging canary scheduled for 1759200000 (tomorrow)

sam: I'll add schema checks and the shadow code.

jamie: I'll prototype the console toggle + banner copy. need a short blurb for release notes.

raj: I'll bake dashboard and alerts, plus a runbook for rollback.

alisa: thanks team. action items: @sam implement shadow normalization + schema check; @raj dashboards/alerts; @jamie console toggle + copy; i'll own rollout orchestration.

sam: noted. :thumbsup:

jamie: adding to roadmap and product notes. :white_check_mark:

raj: will set alert thresholds and runbook in pagerduty.

alisa: we'll reconvene after 48h of shadow data. if all green, propose enabling for all with opt-out.

console-bot: note: new metric `pin_normalize_diff` created (type: counter)

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging (5%). logs: /deploys/1759123456/normalize-pin-feature

sam: quick question — do we need to update SDKs to stop sending full header blobs?

jamie: we should notify partners and add a migration snippet in SDK docs, but not block rollout.

alisa: perfect. closing thread for now. follow-ups in PRs and the canary channel. :rocket:
